source_row.stem: A nurse is discussing colorectal cancer screening options with a client. Available methods generally include:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Limited only to invasive surgical biopsy, rather than including a range of less invasive screening options","B":"Limited to one single universal method, without any alternative screening options available to clients","C":"Colonoscopy, fecal occult blood/immunochemical testing, and other options, selected based on individual risk and preference","D":"Screening options generally considered to lack a supporting evidence base behind their recommended use"}}
source_row.rationale: Colorectal cancer screening includes multiple evidence-based options, including colonoscopy and stool-based tests (fecal occult blood/immunochemical testing), selected based on individual risk factors, preference, and provider discussion.
source_row.source_name: American Cancer Society — Colorectal Cancer Screening Options
